title: Wellspring University 2026/27 School Fees, Admissions & Student Portal
summary: Wellspring University in Benin City has an officially published 2026/27 tuition schedule by programme and year, and says undergraduate admission applications are open. For example, first-year tuition is ₦1,506,600 for Nursing, ₦703,080 for Computer Science and ₦574,000 for Microbiology; acceptance, hostel, clinical and sundry fees can be additional.
feeLabel: 2026/27 tuition varies by programme and study level
feeNote: The university's approved 2026/27 fee table lists 100-level tuition examples: Nursing ₦1,506,600, Medical Laboratory Science ₦1,030,500, Computer Science ₦703,080, Microbiology ₦574,000, Public Health ₦661,000. These are NOT all-inclusive student bills. Official tables list separate acceptance, hostel, clinical posting and sundry charges, some varying by college and level. Generate/confirm the exact tuition and additional fee schedule with the university before payment.
timeline: As of 12 October 2026, Wellspring University advertises 2026/27 admissions as open. The university has not provided one closing deadline that covers every entry route on the checked pages.
requirements: A valid WAEC, NECO or NABTEB O-level result meeting the five relevant credits, subject combination and sitting rules for the chosen programme.
A JAMB UTME record with required subject combination and the admission-year minimum score, or an eligible Direct Entry qualification under the university's published course-specific rules.
A personal email address and telephone number for university admissions communication and follow-up on required original credentials.

For Medicine, Nursing, Computer Science and other courses, match the specific programme requirements, not another college's application route; accepted students must supply the university's registration evidence.
steps: Open Wellspring University's official admissions homepage and select the 2026/27 undergraduate application path after confirming the desired course from its programme directory.
Read the university's Admissions Requirements page for the exact UTME/Direct Entry subjects, five O-level credits, number of permitted sittings and any programme-specific entry condition.

Before submitting an application, open the official 2026/27 Tuition & Fees page and select the relevant college, course and year of study to distinguish tuition from additional acceptance, accommodation, clinical or sundry charges.

Complete the admission form only through the application reached from the university's official website and provide true JAMB, O-level and contact details; keep the receipt for any university-authorised application charge.
Check the university admission response and the corresponding JAMB CAPS record. A submitted application, eligibility score or paid screening charge alone does not establish admission.

After a verified offer, sign in through the student portal linked from the official school website, obtain your exact school-fee invoice and follow the Bursary's approved Remita payment route; separately verify eligibility for accommodation before paying hostel charges.
Keep acceptance and payment receipts and complete the institution's medical, credential-verification and matriculation/course registration instructions for your actual faculty and cohort.
notes: 2026/27 100-level tuition illustrations: Nursing ₦1,506,600; Medical Laboratory Science ₦1,030,500; Public Health ₦661,000; Computer Science ₦703,080; Software Engineering ₦703,080; Microbiology ₦574,000, as separately published in university college tables.

The university's 2026/27 fees page lists first-year hostel accommodation at ₦250,000 in the displayed health/science-college breakdown. Hostel allocation and optionality must be confirmed by the institution.

An official 2026/27 computing-college table gives a ₦50,000 fresh-student acceptance fee and other sundry charges, while the summary fee page gives wider programme-dependent acceptance figures. Do not treat ₦50,000 as a universal university-wide acceptance charge.
The official programme-fee table lists clinical posting amounts for some health programmes in later years; these must not be rolled into the first-year general tuition figure.

Some official fee pages have slightly different presentation/summary totals. The definitive amount is the university's current faculty-and-level breakdown and the student's own portal invoice, not a copied flat all-programme price.
Payments are through university-linked student channels; MyNigeriaGuide does not request admission passwords or collect school fees.
